name: Roz
source:
She is sarcastic but affectionate to other Dray, she sees them all as a large family. She will go out of her way to help a Dray, and to teach about Roof Running.

She has been in Clockwork City all her life, and she has grown to dislike the humans below her. She had a terrible incident when she was a child, and it has forever coloured her image of humans. She has her burdens, but she masks them well, and she dotes on Edyta, treating her like a younger sister.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25899]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
